title: Insurance
description: Every car's policies and when they expire

help.title: About insurance
help.overview: Each policy belongs to one car. A renewal is a new policy, so the old one stays as history.

sections.title: On this page
items: Staff chosen in the rental settings are notified once, 30 days before a policy expires.
Policies past their expiry date are marked expired every morning.
Open a car's menu to see only that car's policies.
